answer.reason: The Gospel verses tell of events by the sea, while the Numbers and Joshua verses only mark boundaries.

clauses.english: was where Jesus called the fishermen Simon and Andrew to follow him
clauses.quote: Follow me, and I will make you fishers of men.

clauses.english: was where Jesus healed the lame, blind and dumb brought to him

doubts: NUM 34:11, JOS 12:3 and JOS 13:27 only give boundaries and were left out.
MAT 9:1 names no sea and was left out.
MRK 7:31 and JHN 6:1 only record Jesus' arrival, and JHN 21:1 says only that he showed himself there, so they were left out.
MAT 15:30 places the healings on a mountain near the sea.
